results.native_terminal: reference calibration incomplete: 91/184 stable qualified invocations, 46 successful; requires 100 qualified and 500‰ successful (complete=true)

lessons.observation: pingu retained its reference; bat/ast-grep replaced the solver-visible reference path before successors. Host independent checks still retained the reference.
lessons.principle: Preserve both completed work and the ability to independently verify further work.
lessons.next_change: Separate immutable input/reference assets from mutable build outputs and carry their usable interfaces across successors.
lessons.validation: A successor can perform a fresh reference comparison after arbitrary candidate builds.

lessons.observation: bat public failures 6->1->0; ast-grep public failures 18->10->5->3->1->1->1->0; later bat received repeated category summaries with unchanged case outcomes.
lessons.principle: Diagnostic feedback should identify a reproducible difference and a useful next action.
lessons.next_change: Provide bounded actionable internal counterexamples or independently generated public equivalents, keeping final official hidden scoring separate.
lessons.validation: A repair closes its motivating counterexample and preserves neighboring passing behavior.

lessons.observation: ast-grep sealed counts 81->83->83->81 masked opposing case changes; a previously passing public rewrite case regressed.
lessons.principle: Remember progress at the level of concrete behaviors and their conditions.
lessons.next_change: Persist runnable regression cases with repairs and replay affected controls before handoff.
lessons.validation: Track both closed and reopened defects; do not infer improvement from commit count or aggregate score alone.

lessons.observation: bat formal outcome signatures were identical for four distinct deliveries; all nine formal assessments skipped the reviewer.
lessons.principle: When changes do not resolve observed problems, reconsider assumptions, representation, and access to evidence.
lessons.next_change: Make diagnostic review available during failure and insufficient-evidence states, independently of acceptance review.
lessons.validation: The next work cycle changes a consequential conclusion or resolves a specific failure, rather than merely producing a new session.

lessons.observation: pingu calibration excluded 90 successful reference invocations with variable output; a separate hang breaker blocked 157 later sealed checks.
lessons.principle: Use observations for the properties they establish; isolate local uncertainty and execution limits.
lessons.next_change: Retain stable observable properties and bound continuous probes explicitly without suppressing unrelated checks.
lessons.validation: Dynamic outputs remain useful and bounded open-ended behavior does not erase unrelated verified progress.

lessons.observation: bat/ast-grep stopped at the three-successor cap with 424/343 requests and approximately 283.5/281.5 minutes remaining; both consumed their eight-publication cap.
lessons.principle: Coordinate work and validation under the original task allocation according to expected task progress.
lessons.next_change: Remove universal inner count gates as routine terminal criteria; retain the external authorized deadline/request ceiling.
lessons.validation: Measure final quality, useful progress and resource use under the same original allocation, without automatic renewal.
